contracts.name: OnSystemUpdate
contracts.note: Live-verified 2026-08-20 on build 4.1.1.7398727. The system table walk was already correct in ecs_system_update.c; a direct array probe confirms it: EntityWorld+0x30 buffer, +0x3c size (934), stride 0xf8, 506 populated entries beginning at slot 311, 491 of them with entry+0x08 == slot, and 501 carrying a non-null UpdateProc at +0x18. Subscribing succeeded for 16 of 24 sampled system names, and a ServerPassive hook fired 462 times in ~12s (~38Hz server tick) then unsubscribed cleanly. Known limits, both documented in ghidra/offsets/ECS_SYSTEM_UPDATE_RECON.md: Client* systems fail against the server world (they live in the client EntityWorld), and the generated name table carries 73 of the 454 exported SystemsContext TypeIds.

contracts.name: RaycastClosest
contracts.note: Undeferred and live-verified 2026-08-20 on build 4.1.1.7398727. The registry's four stated unknowns (C representation, construction, destruction, ownership of the trailing by-value ls::Function<bool(ls::PhysicsShape const*)>) are all resolved by decompilation: the value is 0x40 bytes (MethodTable* at +0x00, Storage at +0x08), passed INDIRECTLY by pointer under AAPCS64, and the callee branches on a null MethodTable straight to the engine's own s_IgnoreFilterClosest -- so an all-zero Function is a first-class 'no shape filter' value requiring neither construction nor destruction. Live 5/6: hit geometry matches the ray's X/Z exactly with a plausible surface normal, sky segment returns nil, mask exclusion returns nil, agrees with RaycastAny/RaycastAll, closest distance equals min-of-all on a clean ray (0.500000 == 0.500000), 2000 casts -> 1485 hits in 19ms with no crash. The one non-passing assertion was an over-strong test expectation, not a defect: where the ray origin sits inside geometry RaycastAll reports a zero-distance hit that RaycastClosest skips, so closest == min(all) does not hold in the degenerate case. See ghidra/offsets/PHYSICS_VMT_AUDIT.md.

contracts.name: RaycastAny
contracts.note: Live stress ladder PASSED 6/6 on 2026-08-20, build 4.1.1.7398727, in a loaded vanilla session. Discriminator (ray straight down through terrain from the host's position) returned true where the closed gate returned false; high-sky segment false (no false positives); include-all hits while exclude-all misses (masks honored); 5000 casts -> 2550 hits in 41ms (~8us/cast, no crash/leak); zero-length and origin rays return safe booleans. Gate advanced to this build's UUID only after re-auditing all 18 physics VMT slots from shipped symbols (ghidra/offsets/PHYSICS_VMT_AUDIT.md); slot 10 disassembles to phx::SimplePhysXScene::RaycastAny with the exact by-value ls::Optional<PhysicsSceneScopedReadLock&> signature proven GO in RAYCAST_ABI_B4A.md.

contracts.name: RaycastAll
contracts.note: Undeferred and live-verified 2026-08-20 on build 4.1.1.7398727. The registry's stated blocker -- that the trailing by-value ls::Optional<PhysicsSceneScopedReadLock&> could not be constructed safely from C -- was false: it is the same disengaged 16-byte optional RaycastAny already ships, and ls::PhysicsHitAll& is the same out-parameter the working SweepAll/TestBox bindings pass. RaycastAll is RaycastAny's register layout with one pointer inserted at position 3. Live test 5/5: a downward ray returns 16 hits whose first Position matches the host's X/Z exactly with Normal [0,1,0]; Distance is a normalized t (0.2552 x 60-unit ray = 15.3 units, the exact drop); agrees with RaycastAny on hit and miss; mask exclusion yields nothing; 300 casts -> 3138 hits in 6ms with no crash. Shares RaycastAny's version+UUID gate. See ghidra/offsets/PHYSICS_VMT_AUDIT.md.
